CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chambers
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, January 3, 2019
  5:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  January 3, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold, MD, Facilitator Karen Orlansky, Director of
  Community Services Nancy Hunt-Coffey, Assistant Director of
  Community Development Ryan Gohlich, Marketing and Economic
  Sustainability Manager Laura Biery, Honorable Kathy Reims,
  Health & Safety Commissioner Myra Lurie, Health & Safety
  Commissioner Daniel Nazarian, Cultural Heritage Commissioner
  Noah Furie, Human Relations Commissioner Ori Blumenfield,
  Planning Commissioner Lori Greene Gordon, Policy and
  Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Senior Planner Timmi Tway,
  Mark Elliott, Sharon Ignarro, Craig Corman, Gabriel Frem, Mark
  Elliot, Anne Ostroff

  1)  Public Comment
   None:
  2)  General Plan Update Topic Committee Reports
   Assistant Director of Community Development Ryan Gohlich provided
  summary regarding the general plan and proposed recommendations.
  3)  La Cienega/Wilshire Focus Area
   Presentation/Discussion regarding transit adjacent development in other
  communities and business districts by Senior Planner Timmi Tway.
   Committee Members requested additional information regarding
  policies and procedure for development.
   Presentation/Discussion regarding La Cienega Park redevelopment by
  Director of Community Services Nancy Hunt-Coffey
   Presented on the outreach results for La Cienega Park and status
  of projects up to date.
   Discussed the various actions that could be taken within the area
  4) Logistics for Future Walking Tour of La Cienega/Wilshire Focus Area
   Walking tour to be scheduled on January 17, 2019.
  5) Adjourn
  Date / Time  January 3, 2019 / 6:32pm
